input: Gou et al. (2024) propose CRITIC, where a frozen LLM verifies and corrects its output by interacting with external tools such as a search engine or a code interpreter. They also report that LLMs are unreliable at self-verification and that the gains depend on tool interaction. Critique a claim that CRITIC shows LLMs can correct their own mistakes without any outside help.
source: Gou et al. 2024, Abstract and Section 5 Conclusion (chunks gou2024-000, gou2024-028)
